### Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Dual-target CDK9-EZH2 inhibitors designed via pharmacophore fusion](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42542216/)** — *PubMed*
  * Researchers designed and synthesized novel dual-targeting inhibitors targeting cyclin-dependent kinase 9 (CDK9) and enhancer of zeste homolog 2 (EZH2).
  * The compounds were generated using a pharmacophore fusion strategy to simultaneously address these key oncogenic targets.

* **[Phenotypic overlap in early and at-risk psychosis spectra](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.03.04.26347618)** — *bioRxiv/medRxiv*
  * A dense multimodal profiling study of 194 participants across familial high-risk (FHR), clinical high-risk (CHR), and first-episode psychosis (FEP) cohorts compared clinical, cognitive, and neuroanatomical spectra.
  * Results showed marked individual phenotypic overlap between CHR and FEP, supporting transdiagnostic clinical staging models over rigid categorical classifications.
  * A shared brain-behavior covariance axis linked reduced cortical thickness to elevated negative and cognitive symptoms, which trended toward predicting lower functional outcomes at a 6-month follow-up.

* **[Translational Review: Glial autophagy-lysosomal-inflammation axis in Alzheimer's disease](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42541636/)** — *PubMed*
  * Proposes a unifying mechanistic framework linking glial autophagy, lysosomal clearance, and neuroinflammatory pathways in the progression of Alzheimer's disease pathology.

* **[Translational Review: Targeting TDP-43 in sporadic ALS](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42541567/)** — *PubMed*
  * Reviews emerging therapeutic strategies and biological mechanisms for targeting TDP-43 pathology, a hallmark of sporadic amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

* **[Network-level dynamics of anti-seizure medications evaluated on MEAs](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42541378/)** — *PubMed*
  * A systematic, multielectrode array (MEA)-based comparative study analyzed the acute, network-level dynamic signatures of various anti-seizure medications to map their functional phenotypes.

* **[In silico evaluation of novel Tricholoma pardinum metabolites](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42541422/)** — *PubMed*
  * Utilized molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations to evaluate the drug-likeness, toxicity, and target interactions of novel metabolites isolated from the fungus *Tricholoma pardinum*.

* **[Translational Review: Dendritic cells in personalized vaccines](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42541646/)** — *PubMed*
  * Highlights historical achievements and future perspectives of personalized vaccines and the key translational role of dendritic cells.

---

### Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Dosing optimization of epcoritamab in R/R follicular lymphoma](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42541678/)** — *PubMed*
  * Conducted exposure-response (E-R) analyses of the CD20 x CD3 bispecific antibody epcoritamab (AbbVie) to characterize the optimal monotherapy dosing regimen in patients with relapsed or refractory (R/R) follicular lymphoma (FL).

---

### Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **[Enlivex proposes controversial $800M RAIN token purchase](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2083550566551310825)** — *BioStocks (X)*
  * Clinical-stage immunotherapy developer Enlivex Therapeutics (`$ENLV`) has proposed an $800 million purchase of RAIN crypto tokens.
  * The proposed transaction has sparked severe dilution concerns, with potential share dilution estimated at up to 950%.

* **[Historical analysis underscores persistent ~90% clinical attrition rates in drug development](https://x.com/paras_biotech/status/2083769179019080131)** — *paras_biotech (X)*
  * A historical review tracking drug development success rates reveals that overall clinical failure rates have remained highly stagnant over several decades.
  * Failure rates registered at ~90% in the 1960s, improved slightly to ~80% in the 1970s and 1980s, and returned to ~90%+ during the 2000s and 2010s.

---

**Worth watching:** The market reaction and investor feedback regarding Enlivex's highly unconventional proposal to purchase $800 million in RAIN tokens, which carries a staggering 950% potential dilution risk.

- Biology & Health
    - [Walnut Mortality Effect](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/SHw5QIlW9lc) -- Physionic
        - Across analyzed meta-analyses, total nut intake consistently correlates with a reduced risk of all-cause mortality, with no individual studies indicating increased mortality risk.
        - The inverse relationship between nut consumption and mortality plateaus at approximately 15 grams per day, which represents about half of a standard serving.
        - Specific to walnuts, higher consumption is associated with lower total mortality in both sexes, though women demonstrate benefits at lower intake levels compared to men.
        - The observed reduction in mortality risk associated with walnut intake remains consistent regardless of overall baseline diet quality.
        - The best available estimate identifies an optimal intake of 28 grams of walnuts two to four times per week (averaging 15 grams daily) for a mild, consistent reduction in mortality risk.
